lance.name: Lance
lance.role: Piercing bolts that ignore armor; single target, slow against crowds.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.role: Slow area shells aimed where the target is now; fast enemies dodge them.

frost.name: Frost
frost.role: Pulses that slow every enemy in range; supports all other towers.

poison.name: Poison
poison.role: Stacking poison cloud; stops regeneration, blocked by shields.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.role: Very long range, slow, heavy shots with triple damage to shields.
